viec.ten: Determining investment policy, capital source and project management model
viec.mo_ta: The construction investment sequence has 3 stages: project preparation, project implementation and construction completion (Clause 1, Article 16 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: Determine or approve the investment policy under the laws on public investment, investment and PPP (specific procedures follow those laws – not yet in our library).

Decide on phased investment, splitting into component projects and independent compensation and resettlement projects (if needed) when deciding or approving the investment policy or when preparing the Feasibility Study Report (Clauses 2 and 3, Article 16).

Determine the type and group of the project to know whether a Feasibility Study Report or an Economic-Technical Report must be prepared (Article 17 of Construction Law; Article 5 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).

Choose the project management model: specialized or regional project management unit (PMU), hiring a project management consultant, an affiliated PMU, or investor self-management (Article 32 of Construction Law; Article 44 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).
ho_so: Document deciding or approving the investment policy (where required).
Document assigning the investor or the project preparation agency (Article 6 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).
lien_ket: Handbook on the construction investment project sequence
viec.luu_y: Public investment capital projects must also comply with the Law on Public Investment (policy, capital plan) – we have not yet loaded this law into our library, so no details are given.

viec.ten: Construction survey
viec.mo_ta: Surveys include topographic, engineering geological and hydrogeological, hydrological and existing-condition surveys of the works, and other survey work (Article 21 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: Prepare and approve the construction survey task (Article 11 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).
Prepare and approve the construction survey technical plan (Article 12).
Carry out the survey; the investor manages the survey work (Article 13).
Accept and approve the Survey Results Report; the investor may require the design contractor or hire a consultant to check the report before approval (Article 15).
ho_so: Approved survey task and survey technical plan.
Survey Results Report (content under Article 14 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP) – a component of the works completion dossier.
lien_ket: Procedure for applying for a building permit for an individual house 2026
can_cu: Article 22 of Construction Law – requirements for surveys
viec.luu_y: The survey task report is part of the mandatory project dossier; for individual houses the law does not separately require this sequence, but a geological survey helps choose a safe foundation.

viec.ten: Prepare the Feasibility Study Report or Economic-Technical Report
viec.mo_ta: The investor or the project preparation agency organizes the preparation of the project (Article 23 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: Determine the planning basis for preparing the project (Article 26 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).
Prepare the construction design task (Article 17).
Prepare the Feasibility Study Report (content under Article 29) or the Economic-Technical Report (Article 30), with the basic design/construction design as prescribed.
Determine the preliminary total investment/construction total investment (Articles 5 and 6 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP).
For works requiring design verification under Clause 5, Article 26 of Construction Law: hire a consultant to verify the design in the Feasibility Study Report.
ho_so: Feasibility Study Report/Economic-Technical Report; accompanying basic design or construction design.
Survey Results Report; verification report (if any); environmental and fire prevention and fighting (PCCC) procedure dossiers under sector-specific laws.

viec.ten: Design of individual houses
viec.mo_ta: Individual houses must comply with standards and technical regulations and ensure safety for neighboring works (Clause 1, Article 10 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).
buoc: Check planning information, building lines and density at the plot before designing.

Determine whether self-design is allowed: a house that is simultaneously under 3 floors, has no basement, has a total floor area under 250 m² and a height under 12 m may be designed by the homeowner (Point a, Clause 2, Article 10); otherwise hire an organization or individual with suitable capacity.

Prepare the permit application drawings (floor plan, elevations, sections, foundation, electricity and water connections) and the commitment on safety of adjacent works (Article 60 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).
ho_so: Set of design drawings; lawful land documents (Article 55 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).
lien_ket: Designing your own house: when must you hire a design firm?

viec.ten: Appraisal and approval of the project (investment decision)
viec.mo_ta: The Feasibility Study Report or Economic-Technical Report must be appraised as the basis for approving the project (Clause 1, Article 26 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: The project preparation agency prepares the dossier for appraisal submission (Article 35 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP; submission using Form No. 01, 04 or 05 of Appendix I).

Appraisal by the investment decision maker (Article 31) and by the specialized construction agency for projects within its authority (Article 27 of Construction Law; Article 32 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).
Submit the dossier at the One-Stop Shop, by post or online; within 5 working days the specialized agency requests supplements once if the dossier is incomplete (Article 36).

Appraisal time of the specialized agency: Group C projects not more than 12 working days (15 days if they include Grade I or higher works); Group B 16 days (20 days); Group A 20 days (25 days); nationally important projects not more than 60 days (Article 37).
The investment decision maker approves the project by decision using Form No. 09 or 10 of Appendix I (Article 39).
ho_so: Appraisal submission; Feasibility Study Report; verification report (if any); legal documents on policy, planning, land and environment.
Notice of appraisal results (Form No. 03, 06, 07 or 08 of Appendix I); decision approving the project.
viec.luu_y: PPP projects: appraised under the law on investment in the form of public-private partnership (Clause 2, Article 26).

viec.ten: Detailed design, appraisal and approval of the design and cost estimate
viec.mo_ta: The investor appraises, controls and approves the detailed construction design after the project is approved (Clause 1, Article 29 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: Prepare the technical design/construction drawing design and technical specifications (Articles 22, 23 and 24 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP); prepare the construction cost estimate (Article 12 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP).
Verify the design for works subject to design verification (Clause 3, Article 29).

The investor appraises the detailed design step immediately before selecting the construction/EPC contractor (Article 41 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP); public investment projects are appraised according to the content in Clause 1, Article 30 of Construction Law.
Appraise the cost estimate together with the design (Article 16 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP).
Approve the design and cost estimate by decision (Form No. 13 of Appendix I) (Article 42 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP; Article 17 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP); update the cost estimate in the database.
ho_so: Design dossier bearing the approval stamp; verification report (if any); construction cost estimate; decision approving the design and cost estimate.

viec.ten: Appraisal of the fire prevention and fighting design
viec.mo_ta: The investor must comply with the requirements of the law on fire prevention and fighting (PCCC) (Clause 4, Article 29 of Construction Law).
buoc: Check whether the works fall under Appendix III of Decree 105/2025/ND-CP (the PCCC design must be appraised by the police authority) (Clause 1, Article 9 of Decree 105/2025/ND-CP).
The PCCC design solutions are assessed when appraising the design/Feasibility Study Report (Point d, Clause 1, Article 30 of Construction Law).

Submit the PCCC design appraisal dossier (fire alarm system, fire fighting system, electricity for PCCC, etc.) to the police authority (Article 9 of Decree 105/2025/ND-CP, as amended by Article 14 of Decree 347/2026/ND-CP).
ho_so: Request for appraisal (Form PC11), land documents/policy documents, PCCC design documents; PCCC design appraisal document.
lien_ket: Fire safety design appraisal: which works must undergo it?
can_cu: Article 17 of Law on Fire Prevention, Fire Fighting and Rescue 2024

viec.ten: Applying for a building permit
viec.mo_ta: Before commencement, the investor must have a building permit, except in exempt cases (Clause 2, Article 43 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: Determine whether a permit exemption applies (Clause 2, Article 43) and the type of permit: new construction, repair – renovation – relocation, or temporary (Clause 1, Article 43).
Prepare the dossier according to the type of works (Articles 56–62 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP); for individual houses follow Article 60.
Submit the dossier online on the National Public Service Portal; submit in person or by post only if there is a technical incident (Clause 1, Article 54).

Receive the permit: individual houses within 7 working days; other works 10 working days (new issuance, relocation, temporary) or 9 working days (adjustment, repair, renovation); extension or reissuance 5 working days (Point b, Clause 1, Article 54).
Post/publicly display the permit at the construction site (Article 66).
ho_so: Application for the permit (Appendix II form of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP); lawful land documents (Article 55); design drawings; design appraisal results/PCCC results where required by law.
lien_ket: Procedure for applying for a building permit for an individual house 2026
Which individual houses are exempt from a building permit?
viec.luu_y: Permit-issuing authority for individual houses: commune-level People's Committee (Article 53 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).

viec.ten: Selecting contractors and signing construction contracts
viec.mo_ta: Contractor selection using State budget capital and the cases in Article 2 of Law on Bidding 2023 must follow the Law on Bidding; for projects with other capital and for individual houses, the investor selects a capable contractor itself.
buoc: Projects within the scope of the Law on Bidding: prepare and approve the contractor selection plan (Articles 38 and 39 of Law on Bidding); the investor approves the bid package cost estimate in place of the bid package price (Clause 3, Article 17 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP).

Organize contractor selection according to the process: preparation, organization, bid evaluation, negotiation, submission – appraisal – approval – publication of results, finalization and contract signing (Article 43 of Law on Bidding).

Check contractor capacity: organizations self-publish their capacity; individuals holding positions must have practicing certificates (Article 88 of Construction Law; Article 41 of Decree 212/2026/ND-CP).
Draft and sign a contract with full content (Article 7 of Decree 210/2026/ND-CP): scope of work, quality, schedule, contract price, advance payment, payment, security, warranty, penalties, disputes.
Receive the performance security (if agreed; for public investment/PPP projects at 2%–10% of the contract price – Article 13 of Decree 210/2026/ND-CP).
ho_so: Contractor selection plan and results (if under the Law on Bidding); bid/proposal documents; contract and appendices; performance guarantee.
viec.luu_y: Law on Bidding No. 22/2023/QH15 is partly no longer in effect; the amending documents and guiding decrees are not yet in our library – check the current version before applying.

viec.ten: Commencement conditions, insurance, commencement notice
viec.mo_ta: Commencement requires the conditions in Clause 1, Article 48 of Construction Law 2025 (except special cases in Clauses 2 and 3).
buoc: Construction site available for handover in whole or in part (Point a, Clause 1, Article 48).
Building permit (if required) and approved construction drawing design for the part being commenced (Points b and c).
Contracts signed with contractors performing the related construction activities (Point d).

Purchase compulsory insurance: works insurance during construction (for works subject to it), and employee insurance and third-party civil liability insurance purchased by the construction contractor (Article 10 of Construction Law).

Send the commencement notice (in person, by post or online) using the Appendix V form of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP to the local state construction management agency – households and individuals building individual houses need not send it (Point đ, Clause 1, Article 48; Article 12 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).
Install the project signboard and site barriers (Article 13 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).
ho_so: Site handover record; building permit; decision approving the construction drawing design; contracts; insurance contracts; commencement notice.

viec.ten: Contract advance payment
viec.mo_ta: The advance payment rate, number of installments, timing, guarantee and recovery are agreed by the parties in the contract (Clause 2, Article 12 of Decree 210/2026/ND-CP).
buoc: The contract is effective; for construction contracts, there must be a site clearance plan or a site handover record (Point a, Clause 3, Article 12 – public investment, PPP projects).
Receive an advance payment guarantee when the advance exceeds VND 1 billion (Point c, Clause 3, Article 12 – public investment, PPP projects).

Transfer the advance; minimum rate for construction contracts: 10% (over VND 50 billion), 15% (VND 10–50 billion), 20% (under VND 10 billion) (Point i, Clause 3, Article 12 – public investment, PPP projects).
Gradually recover the advance through payments as agreed.
ho_so: Advance payment request; advance payment guarantee (if any); for State budget projects: payment documents through the State Treasury (see the forms of Decree 347/2025).
lien_ket: Advance payment and payment dossiers for public investment capital through the State Treasury (Decree 254/2025) – public investment capital projects

viec.ten: Construction management: methods, schedule, safety, diary
viec.mo_ta: The construction contractor receives the site, establishes the construction management system and submits plans and methods to the investor for acceptance (Article 15 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).
buoc: The contractor notifies the construction management system (site manager, persons in charge of technical matters, quality, safety, quantities, schedule and records) (Clause 2, Article 15).
Submit to the investor for acceptance: the testing and inspection plan, material control measures, construction and safety methods, schedule and acceptance plan (Clause 3, Article 15).
Control incoming materials, products, components and equipment (Article 14 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).
Identify danger zones, implement safety measures and assign trained safety managers (Clauses 4 and 5, Article 15; Article 51 of Construction Law).
Manage quantities and construction schedule (Articles 18 and 19 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP); keep the construction diary.
ho_so: Construction management system; accepted construction and safety methods; schedule; testing and acceptance plans; construction diary.
viec.luu_y: The construction diary template is Appendix II of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP – our library does not yet have the full text of the appendix.

viec.ten: Construction supervision and acceptance of work items and stages
viec.mo_ta: Works must be supervised for quality, quantities, schedule, occupational safety and environmental protection; supervision is encouraged for individual houses (Clause 1, Article 56 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: The investor organizes supervision (self-performed or by hiring a supervision consultant) according to the content in Clause 1, Article 20 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.

The contractor requests acceptance; the supervisor accepts the work within not more than 24 hours of receiving the request, and if it does not agree it must reply in writing stating the reasons (Clause 3, Article 22).
Prepare the work acceptance record including: name of the work; time and place; signatories; conclusion; signatures; appendices (Clauses 4 and 5, Article 22).
Accept stages/parts of the works when the parties agree (end of a stage, end of a bid package) (Article 23).
Works subject to acceptance inspection: coordinate with the competent authority to inspect during construction (Article 25).
ho_so: Acceptance request; acceptance records for materials, work items and stages; testing and monitoring results; supervision report.

viec.ten: Interim contract payments
viec.mo_ta: Payment must suit the contract type and contract price; the employer pays in full and on time after deducting advance payments and retained amounts (Clause 2, Article 87 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: Accept the quantities and work completed in the payment period.

The contractor prepares the payment dossier suitable to the contract type, confirmed by the employer/consultant (Clause 1, Article 29 of Decree 210/2026/ND-CP); public investment and PPP projects follow the components in Clauses 2–12.
Reconcile advance recovery and retention for warranty/other items under the contract.
Pay in the form and within the time agreed (Article 28 of Decree 210/2026/ND-CP).
ho_so: Quantity acceptance record; statement of the value of completed quantities; payment request; for State budget projects: documents through the State Treasury.
lien_ket: Advance payment and payment dossiers for public investment capital through the State Treasury (Decree 254/2025) – public investment capital projects

viec.ten: Adjusting the design, project, contract and permit
viec.mo_ta: Changes during implementation must follow the corresponding procedure – an adjustment made without the proper procedure is a major risk in inspections and final settlement.
buoc: Project adjustment: only in the cases in Article 28 of Construction Law; re-appraisal by the specialized agency when it falls under Clause 2, Article 40 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP.
Detailed design adjustment: only in the cases in Clause 1, Article 31 of Construction Law; the investor re-appraises and re-approves (Article 43 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).

Adjust the building permit when changing the external architecture (in areas with architectural management), location, area, number of floors, main structure or main functional zoning (Clause 1, Article 63 of Decree 217/2026/ND-CP).
Amend the contract in writing while the contract is in effect, in the cases in Clause 2, Article 84 of Construction Law (Articles 22–25 of Decree 210/2026/ND-CP).
Adjust the cost estimate and total investment when changes occur (Articles 10 and 18 of Decree 206/2026/ND-CP).
ho_so: Document approving/deciding the adjustment; approved adjusted design and cost estimate; contract appendix; adjusted permit.

viec.ten: Completion acceptance, PCCC acceptance, acceptance inspection
viec.mo_ta: Works may be put into operation only after being accepted as prescribed (Clause 2, Article 57 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: Check that conditions are met: construction fully per design; work items and stages accepted; testing and inspection results satisfactory; compliance with PCCC and environmental requirements (Clause 1, Article 24 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).

The investor organizes PCCC acceptance, is responsible for the results and declares them in the PCCC Database before putting the works into operation (Article 16 of Decree 347/2026/ND-CP, amending Article 12 of Decree 105/2025/ND-CP).
The investor organizes and directly participates in completion acceptance and prepares the record (Article 24).
Works subject to acceptance inspection must have a document from the competent authority accepting the acceptance results before being put into use (Clause 2, Article 29; Article 27).
Have an environmental permit/environmental registration if required (Clause 4, Article 29).
ho_so: Completion acceptance record; PCCC acceptance results; document accepting the acceptance results (if subject to inspection); as-built drawings.
lien_ket: As-built completion and registering the house on the land use right certificate

viec.ten: Handing over the works, preparing and archiving records
viec.mo_ta: Handover only after acceptance as prescribed and with operational safety assured (Clause 1, Article 58 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: The investor prepares the works completion dossier under Appendix VII of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP (Article 28 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).
The contractor hands over to the investor the as-built drawings, operation procedure (if any), maintenance procedure, list of equipment and spare parts (Clause 2, Article 30).
The investor receives the works and hands them over to the owner/managing user together with 1 set of records for management and use (Appendix X) (Clauses 3 and 5, Article 30).
Archiving: the investor keeps the appraisal records and completion dossier; management and use records are kept for at least the service life of the works (Article 42 of Construction Law).
ho_so: Handover record; works completion dossier; management and use records; maintenance procedure.

viec.ten: Final settlement and liquidation of contracts
viec.mo_ta: The contract must specify settlement and liquidation, including unilateral cases (Clause 1, Article 87 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: The contractor prepares the final settlement dossier suitable to the contract type, confirmed by the employer/consultant (Clause 1, Article 30 of Decree 210/2026/ND-CP); public investment and PPP projects follow the components and deadlines in Clauses 2 and 3.
Reconcile the value paid, remaining advance, variations and deductions.

Liquidate the contract when obligations are completed or the contract is terminated (Clause 2, Article 31); public investment and PPP projects may agree on automatic expiry or prepare a liquidation record (Clause 3, Article 31).
ho_so: Completion acceptance record; final settlement value calculation; approved variation records; liquidation record (if any).

viec.ten: Final settlement of investment capital for completed projects
viec.mo_ta: A project that is completed, handed over or discontinued must undergo final settlement of investment capital (Clause 2, Article 79 of Construction Law 2025). Decree 193/2026/ND-CP applies to projects using public investment capital, recurrent expenditure capital and other State budget capital.
buoc: Prepare the final settlement report determining: capital implemented, costs proposed for settlement, damage costs, costs not included in asset value, and value of assets formed (Article 6 of Decree 193/2026/ND-CP); forms follow Circular 73/2026/TT-BTC.
Audit the final settlement report where it is subject to audit (Article 9).
Submit the dossier for verification (Article 7) within the deadline: Group C 4 months, Group B 6 months, Group A and nationally important 9 months from handover for use (Article 21).
The lead agency verifies (Group C 2 months, Group B 2.5 months, Group A 4 months) and submits for approval of the final settlement (Articles 10–18; Article 21).
ho_so: Final settlement report and the forms of Circular 73/2026 (01–09/QTDA); audit report (if any); legal documents, contracts, contract final settlement.

viec.ten: Works warranty
viec.mo_ta: The construction contractor warrants the works it built; the equipment supplier warrants the equipment (Article 64 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: Agree in the contract on the warranty period, form and value, and on holding and returning the warranty money/guarantee (Clause 2, Article 32 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).

The warranty period runs from the investor's acceptance; for State-funded works: not less than 24 months (special grade, Grade I) or 12 months (other grades); warranty money is at least 3% or 5% of the contract value (Clauses 5 and 7, Article 32).
On discovering damage or defects: the investor/owner/managing user notifies and requests warranty; the contractor carries out the warranty after receiving the notice (Article 33).
At the end of the period: the investor confirms completion of the warranty and returns the warranty money/guarantee (Clause 2, Article 32).
ho_so: Warranty guarantee/money; warranty request notice; record confirming completion of the warranty.

viec.ten: Maintenance and works safety assessment
viec.mo_ta: Works must be maintained during operation; the maintenance procedure is prepared and approved by the investor before the works are put into use (Clause 1, Article 65 of Construction Law 2025).
buoc: Prepare and approve the maintenance procedure with content under Article 34 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP.
The owner/managing user prepares the annual maintenance plan (work, time, method, cost) (Article 35).
Carry out inspection, upkeep, repair, monitoring and testing according to the plan (Articles 36, 37 and 38); determine maintenance costs (Article 39).
Large-scale, technically complex works affecting community safety: periodic safety assessment (Clause 4, Article 65; Articles 40 and 41 of Decree 207/2026/ND-CP).
ho_so: Approved maintenance procedure; annual maintenance plan; inspection, repair, monitoring and testing records.
